data.gender_notes: Minaj is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Mīnā’ meaning 'Moon'. In Hindu mythology, the moon goddess is known as ‘Chandra Mata’, who is believed to bless her devotees with prosperity and happiness. The name Minaj carries the meaning “Moon Goddess” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Mythological tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Minaj usually hope their child will grow to embody moon goddess and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes femininity, intuition, and nurturing energy.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Minaj total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
